Name: Open Hand
Notes: THE WORKED EXAMPLE FOR SHOW. Playing this card face up is worth +2 attack and defence to it for the whole round - but the other side now answers a card they can see, and takes their best in that tier instead of picking blind. That trade is the trigger

Name: Called Shot
Notes: The same bargain paid into the SHOT instead of the card, which is where the tier ladder says a bonus belongs. Show it, and if your side takes the shot this round it is worth three more

Name: A Word With The Ref
Notes: KARL'S CARD (Bergmännlein, Belial set, Tier I P2): "Consume 3 Ore: Add +1% to enemy Yellow Card chance (Max 5)". Every time he attacks, a foul the OTHER side commits and the referee sees is 1% likelier to be a yellow instead of a free kick, for the rest of the match, five times at most. THE ORE COST IS NOT CHARGED YET: there is no Ore counter in a match to spend. When there is, change the Trigger to the Ore one and nothing else.

Name: Gremory's Emblem - Rose Unit
Notes: GREMORY'S BASIC SIDE (round Z). When the second water unit of a round enters the exhaust, a Rose Unit token takes the place of one of your water Tier I units: same power, no ability text. The unit it replaced waits in the exhaust - where its 'While in exhaust' side works. Once a round for the whole side.

Name: Zepar's Emblem - Swan
Notes: ZEPAR'S BASIC SIDE (round Z). A water unit that is revealed becomes a Swan for the rest of the match. ROUND AA: Ask = yes - you are asked whether to transform (ruling Q6). The other side and AUTO always say yes.

Name: Zepar's Emblem - Swan wings
Notes: ZEPAR'S BASIC SIDE, second half: a Swan is +1 in every combat. ('Attack Power during combat' read as the power it fights with - ruling R18.)

Name: Sallos's Emblem - Song
Notes: SALLOS'S BASIC SIDE (round Z). A water unit that defends and wins puts a Song counter on the enemy it beat, for the match. Songs do nothing yet by themselves - Sallos's Ultimate (phase C8) reads them.

Name: Belphegor - victory counter
Notes: BELPHEGOR'S BASIC SIDE (round Z). A fire unit winning its combat puts a victory counter on the Emblem (your side). Only two per cycle, for the whole side.

Name: Buer - a counter received
Notes: BUER'S BASIC SIDE (round Z). A fire unit that receives a counter is +1 in its combat - this one if it is fighting now, otherwise its next. Once per cycle per unit (ruling R06).

Name: Vassago's Emblem - next air resolves earlier
Notes: VASSAGO'S BASIC SIDE (round AE, C7). When an air unit wins its combat, your next air unit gets -1 on its priority check - it resolves EARLIER (lower goes first).

Name: Glasya-Labolas's Emblem - touched the ball
Notes: GLASYA-LABOLAS'S BASIC SIDE (round AE, C7). An air unit that touched the ball before the PLAY MAKER (it says TOUCHED on its card) is +1 in its combat.

Name: Caim's Emblem - an air swap
Notes: CAIM'S BASIC SIDE (round AE, C7). When an air unit swaps places with another air unit of its tier during combat (from the exhaust before the duel, or from the cards still to play), the enemy it fights is -1.

Name: Plain Star - a push
Notes: ROUND AN (your note). The plain Stars of the opposition early in a new game (data/EnemyIntroSquad2.csv): when this Star duels, the NEXT normal, non-elemental player of its side is +1 in its duel. Nothing else.

Name: Beer Courage
Notes: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL (Anthony, 7 Oct): Koch after his beers at the TIME OUT. +1 power for each of your normal (not Star) players who played before him this round - the lower Tiers. On both his sides (attack and defend), given in the match by MatchTalk.csv Do  ability:Koch=TUT_KOCH_BEER. DRAFT: the number and the wording are yours to change.

Name: Earth Courage
Notes: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL (Anthony, 8 Oct): Bergmännlein Koch after the Earth Brew at the second TIME OUT. When he ATTACKS: 5 stamina off the enemy keeper. His defend side is TUT_KOCH_EARTH_DEF. Given by MatchTalk.csv Do ability:Koch=TUT_KOCH_EARTH/TUT_KOCH_EARTH_DEF.

Name: Earth Courage
Notes: ROUND AN - THE TUTORIAL (Anthony, 8 Oct): Bergmännlein Koch's defend side. When he DEFENDS: 3 stamina off the enemy keeper. His attack side is TUT_KOCH_EARTH.

Name: Plain Beer: Shot in the Dark
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER (Brews.csv plain_goalie). The good side: when he attacks, 1 stamina off the enemy keeper.

Name: Plain Beer: Own Goal Nerves
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER. The catch: when he defends, 1 stamina off YOUR OWN keeper.

Name: Plain Beer: Dutch Courage
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER (plain_power). The good side: +1 power when he attacks.

Name: Plain Beer: Wobbly Legs
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER. The catch: -1 power when he defends.

Name: Plain Beer: A Round for the Keeper
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER (plain_keeper). The good side: when he attacks, 1 stamina back to your keeper.

Name: Plain Beer: A Round for Theirs
Notes: ROUND AN - PLAIN BEER. The catch: when he defends, 1 stamina back to THEIR keeper.
